text.p: Italian bonds and Btp futures ended little changed from the previous close after a session which saw prices yo-yoing around with no real conviction, traders said.

Btps started weak then rose after the Bundesbank denied any emergency council meeting was planned, fell again then recovered only to lose ground on profit-taking on the market rumours of Kohl's death.
"So many fluctuations led to a lot of playing around," one dealer said. "Some who were short bought while others who had bought on the calls took profits at the end of the session."
The September Btp Liffe future ended eight basis points off at 135.64 and slipped a touch lower in APT trade.
